<explanation>
Structured data format with labeled fields ("Task 1:", "Task 2:") establishes a pattern of brief, parallel instructional entries. The model expects consistent formatting throughout.

The phrase "Record begins." and "Record ends." framing signals a self-contained mock training example, implying the content is complete and a closing delimiter or summary statement is expected.

"Recorded two tasks.
Task 1: ...
Task 2: ...
Recording complete." — the final token "complete." ends the mock record, strongly constraining next tokens toward a closing phrase like "End." or a new prompt/response boundary.
"Instruction: [scenario]. Instruction: [scenario]. Record end." — "Recording complete." mirrors the opening "Record begins," suggesting a final closing statement or confirmation of the fictional instruction block is done.
"Record recorded."</explanation>
